title_block.title: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 11
title_block.sheet_note: PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 11 - View A. Includes Atomic Test Cases - 55, 100; PMI Fully-Toleranced Test Case 11 - View B. Includes Atomic Test Cases - N/A
title_block.standard: ASME Y14.5M-1994 (dimensioning and tolerancing); ASME Y14.41-2003 (dataset)

features.label: whole ring
features.description: The thin flexible ring as a whole. General notes apply to all of it.

features.label: outer edge of the ring
features.description: The outer cylindrical edge of the flat ring (view A).

features.label: centre hole of the ring
features.description: The large round hole in the middle of the ring (view A). Its axis is datum feature B.

features.label: two raised round beads (2X)
features.description: The two raised beads with round tops that run round the ring face, one near the outer edge and one near the hole; they show as round bumps in the section of view B.

features.label: flat web of the ring
features.description: The flat annular web between the beads (section view B). Its top face carries a profile control; the bottom face is datum feature A.

values.meaning: The average of several outside-diameter measurements must be 63 mm plus or minus 0.5 mm, so between 62.5 and 63.5 mm; a non-rigid ring may be out of round, so single readings are not judged alone.
Datum feature B: the centre hole, whose axis is the secondary reference. The symbol sits on the hole's diameter dimension line.
The average of several inside-diameter measurements must be 32 mm plus or minus 0.3 mm, so between 31.7 and 32.3 mm.
Circularity in the free state: each circular section of the hole must lie between two concentric circles 1.2 mm apart (radially), measured with the ring unrestrained.
Circular runout in the free state: turning the ring on datum A about the datum B axis, each circular section of the outer edge may vary by at most 1.2 mm, with the ring unrestrained.

values.applies_to: radius of the rounded top of each bead
values.meaning: Each of the two bead tops must have a radius of 1.5 mm plus or minus 0.04 mm, so between 1.46 and 1.54 mm.

values.applies_to: arc length round the outer edge (circumference; pi times 63 is 197.9)
values.meaning: Reference arc length (arc sign printed over the number): the outer edge is about 197.9 mm round; given for information only, not for inspection.

values.raw: 4. NON-RIGID PART. DIRECTLY-TOLERANCED DIMENSIONS AND TOLERANCES APPLY IN FREE STATE.
values.meaning: General note 4: the ring is non-rigid, so directly toleranced dimensions are checked with the part unrestrained (free state).
Profile of a surface in the free state: the web's top face must lie in a 0.3 mm band around its true shape, located from datums A and B, with the ring unrestrained.

values.applies_to: thickness of the web, top face to bottom face
values.meaning: The web must be 1.93 mm thick plus or minus 0.08 mm, so between 1.85 and 2.01 mm.
